suggested_title: Reconcile T8.1a against main after all coverage repairs
description:
Outcome: after all five gen-1 gap repairs and evidence PR #1354 are merged to main, produce a fresh read-only gen-2 spec-to-code reconciliation of T8.1a for parent hud-bstmy.2. Report every negative/universal requirement and every guard instrument with file:line evidence classed implemented, partial, missing or deviates; issue closure is based on verified main behavior, not old evidence or deleted names. Gen-1 hud-bstmy.2.6 found residual dead resource/protocol/scene islands, empty session error hints and real-time invariant polling. Concrete repairs are R=hud-bstmy.2.7, P=hud-bstmy.2.8, S=hud-bstmy.2.9, E=hud-bstmy.2.10 and T=hud-bstmy.2.11. Maintenance authority: docs/scope.md:37 (T8 delete code without a current user), :62–65 (prefer deletion and behavior tests while preserving invariants), docs/vision.md:85–99 and :107 (delete deferred islands; no future-facing frameworks), and the current docs/invariants.md. Pre-reset RFC/OpenSpec/doctrine are history, not authority. Read each original sibling requirement (.2.1–.2.5), these five repaired packets/PRs, and the parent acceptance directly. Evidence: test_results/reconciliation/hud-bstmy.2.6/report.md, follow-ups.json, source/test inventories and dead-code-*.log, in PR #1354 https://github.com/tzeusy-org/tze-hud/pull/1354. Cited lines are baseline 17de3331b11a1ee55fa22197fd13b99b26dac267; re-grep current main before acting.

Non-goals: implementation/test/code edits, changing owner trust/auth posture or specs to match gaps, inventing missing production callers from tests/comments/name collisions, new guard species, duplicating separately owned pre-reset cleanup hud-bstmy.8.3, or closing issues yourself. This is the single terminal gen-2 reconciliation for this parent; do not create parallel subsystem recon beads. If gaps remain, return dedupe-ready exact gap candidates and a proposed gen-3 follow-up for coordinator; gen-3 is the ceiling and gen-4 is forbidden. Protected T7 caller surface: crates/tze_hud_projection/**; crates/tze_hud_runtime/src/portal_projection_driver.rs and src/windowed/portal.rs; crates/tze_hud_input/src/{composer_draft,portal_resize}.rs; crates/tze_hud_config/src/portal_tokens.rs; crates/tze_hud_mcp/src/portal_op.rs; tests/integration/text_stream_portal_*.rs. Do not edit these files or remove public symbols used by those real production paths until hud-lirh2 lands. The five scene-portal-to-proto converters at protocol/convert.rs:1029,1073,1121,1160,1232 remain excluded.
design:
Surface/trust map: read all current resource/protocol/scene production and test surfaces owned by original children hud-bstmy.2.1–.2.5 and new repairs hud-bstmy.2.7–.2.11, plus all actual callers in app/crates/examples/tests. Confirm the live boundary chain (AgentDirectory and Init/Resume identification, capability admission, mutation/upload conversion, SceneGraph/lease/policy authority, ResourceStore/ResidentLedger/RuntimeWidgetStore, runtime consumers) and separate production from test/dev and deferred T7 callers. Audit scene-side policy, pure policy evaluators and direct runtime enforcement when classifying retained items; do not mistake their ownership. Verify protobuf TimingHints versus deleted scene TimingHints by actual type, and every grouped reexport/cfg path. Include wire/session envelopes and the actual disconnect cleanup time source. No production data or secrets may enter evidence.

Audit matrix: verify normal handshake/upload/mutation lifecycle and named invariants, all rejection hints and stable code categories, concurrent session/resource isolation and actual completion observation, resume/replay/idempotence and cleanup/reclamation, current defaults/serialization compatibility and protected T7 behavior. Read real handlers/call sites and nearest existing gates; test presence or success does not prove universal coverage. Re-enumerate every production rejection constructor/path and every pre-existing deletion obligation. Evaluate each instrument for source roots, regex limits, name/cfg ambiguity, timeout/clock provenance, and blind spots: advisory scripts/dead_code.py does not include app, counts inline tests/comments, conflates unrelated names, and retains grouped reexports; its exit only establishes compiler completion. No newly invented parallel test suite.

Sequencing/readiness: suggested blocking dependencies are the five concrete repair IDs only. Original .2.1–.2.5 are already closed antecedents but their merge/main reachability still requires verification. External prerequisite is PR #1354 state MERGED with merged commit/evidence reachable on main; do not depend on hud-bstmy.2.6 closure, and do not create a .2.6/GEN2 cycle. Before recon, confirm every repair PR is merged and the current fetched main contains each outcome; closed status alone is insufficient. Use a fresh isolated audit head and record its SHA, tool versions and exact commands. Rollback is removal of a report-only artifact; no runtime migration/state change.

Docs impact: production/spec/API docs are read-only; create only the durable gen-2 report/evidence under test_results/reconciliation/hud-bstmy.2.12/ (selectively force-add allowed by AGENTS), with valid Discovered-Follow-Ups-JSON and Blockers-JSON arrays. Commit/push an evidence-only PR and coordinator confirms its main landing before terminal closure; a nonempty gap set keeps the recon blocked awaiting materialized repairs and, if needed, one gen-3 terminal follow-up. Do not close it yourself. Tests: +0 ~0 -0. Re-run exact four sibling deletion inventories, full current named-invariant definition inventory, actual narrowed lib scans and affected existing behavior gates from a recorded current main head; no new code/tests. CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 and repository just/llvmpipe recipes constrain execution. Cohesion override: one cross-child recon is intentionally broader than one subsystem because the terminal requirement is to detect seams, universal path gaps and weak instruments across all five repairs; separate subsystem recon would duplicate gates and miss ownership crossings.
acceptance_criteria:
1. Before auditing, verify PR #1354 is MERGED and its evidence is reachable on main; verify hud-bstmy.2.7/.2.8/.2.9/.2.10/.2.11 outcomes and original .2.1–.2.5 merged outcomes are present on the recorded fetched main SHA. No dependency on .2.6 closure and no self/cyclic deps. If an external prerequisite is absent, report its exact blocker and do not claim repaired-state reconciliation.
2. Read parent/all sibling requirements against current docs/scope.md T8/Working rules, docs/invariants.md and docs/vision.md. Produce a complete file:line coverage checklist with implemented/partial/missing/deviates classifications. Sweep every negative/universal requirement across pre-existing production and tests, including resource validation/refcount, protocol helpers/exports, scene timing/helpers, every rejection envelope/hint and no-sleep invariant instrument. Explicitly preserve protected T7 callers/type distinctions.
3. Repeat the four exact deletion checks and named-invariant inventory (72 names at baseline; validate the current complete set exactly once each), current symbol/caller inventories and actual narrowed resource/protocol/scene lib scans. Audit all scanner roots/cfg/name/reexport blind spots and guard coverage; distinguish compile success from no dead code and test existence from behavior execution. Report each retained diagnostic with a real production caller or necessary named test fixture.
4. Run affected existing resource/protocol/scene behavior gates at the real seams: eight store_behavior rejection/admission gates; identity/token/fuzz/replay and E hint gates; live timing/TTL/policy and all three T disconnect/resume/grace gates. Verify failure/concurrency/idempotence/retry/compatibility and time-source authority from current code plus results. No new source-scan/property/snapshot/mirror suite. Record exact commands, SHA, versions, outputs and Tests: +0 ~0 -0, using CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=1 and applicable repository gates.
5. Persist report and bounded evidence in test_results/reconciliation/hud-bstmy.2.12/, with exact spec/source/test links and valid Discovered-Follow-Ups-JSON/Blockers-JSON arrays. Each gap candidate carries observed behavior, named nearest gate and exact proposed test delta plus a dedupe key; cross-check active/closed repairs before proposing work. Return a proposed gen-3 only if gaps remain, blocked behind concrete materialized gap IDs and evidence merge, never a future self-dependency or gen-4.
6. Keep production/spec/test sources read-only, commit/push the evidence-only outcome and open a reviewable report PR. Coordinator alone applies tracker changes and closes after main merge confirmation and a clean gap set; unresolved gaps remain blocked with branch-pushed recovery. Report documentation impact as evidence-only and preserve current auth/trust/schema semantics.
readiness_reason: Blocked on all five concrete repair IDs being merged on main and evidence PR #1354 merged/reachable; coordinator verifies graph and ownership. Never depend on .2.6 closure.
